help.baudRate: Leave empty to use the machine's usual speed. Change it only if the analyzer's own settings use another one.

messages.noPortsFound: No ports found. Type a custom path.
messages.autoOpenReport: Open generated report automatically after save
messages.portInUse: This port is already used by {{device}}. Only one enabled machine can listen on a port: switch that one off or pick another port.

port_missing.title: Not connected: {{port}} is gone from this PC
port_missing.action: Check the USB cable between the analyzer and this PC. We reconnect by ourselves.

port_busy.title: Another program is using {{port}}
port_busy.action: Close the analyzer's own PC software or a second Arkivet window, then press Reconnect.

access_denied.title: This computer user can't open {{port}}
access_denied.action: Ask whoever set up this PC to allow access to the port, then press Reconnect.

disconnected.title: Lost the connection on {{port}}
disconnected.action: Check that the analyzer is on and the cable is plugged in. We reconnect by ourselves.

folder_missing.title: Can't find the results folder ({{directory}})
folder_missing.action: Is the lab PC on and the folder shared? We keep checking every 30 seconds.

folder_lost.title: Lost the results folder ({{directory}})
folder_lost.action: Check the lab PC and the network. We start again as soon as the folder is back.

not_a_folder.title: The results path is a file, not a folder ({{directory}})
not_a_folder.action: Pick the folder in Settings → Devices.

unknown.title: Can't reach the device
unknown.action: Press Reconnect. If it keeps happening, send the details below to support.

listener_stopped.title: Stopped listening on {{port}}
listener_stopped.action: Press Reconnect. If it happens again, send the details below to support.

events.parseFailedAction: The raw data is kept in Recent Device Files. Send the result again from the analyzer, or tell support.
events.emptyResult: {{device}} sent a result with no values
events.emptyResultAction: Check the test on the analyzer and send it again.
events.cutOff: A result from {{device}} was cut off
events.cutOffAction: Send it again from the analyzer.
events.saveFailed: A result from {{device}} arrived but couldn't be saved as a backup
events.saveFailedAction: Import it now. If this repeats, check the disk space and tell support.
events.folderLostAction: Check the lab PC and the network. We start again as soon as the folder is back.

recentFiles.couldNotReadHint: The device sent data we couldn't read. The raw file is kept for support.
